pages.text: Hunt bosses for the 42 unique named weapons. In IridescentCraft, every Simply Swords unique drops only from a boss.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Simply Swords weapons are the best weapons available. Each unique belongs to one specific boss, with its own drop chance, and is as much a trophy as a tool.$(br2)$(bold)Weapon types:$() Greatswords, Longswords, Katanas, Spears, Staffs, Warglaives, Scythes, Sabres, and more.

$(bold)How to get them:$() Kill the matching boss; there is no other source. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon).$(br2)$(bold)Enchanting compatibility:$() Every Simply Swords unique works with Apotheosis enchanting and affix reforging. A unique with Legendary affixes and max enchants is the endgame weapon ceiling.

$(bold)Reference:$() Each unique has its own tooltip, JEI lists all the standard weapons, and the Codex's $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Unique Weapons$(/l) entry maps every boss to its weapon.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pick a target boss from that list and earn your first unique.$()
